# 交易记录

## OpenAPI Specification

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /cardTransaction:
    post:
      summary: 交易记录
      deprecated: false
      description: >-
        > 本页展示的是加密前的请求参数和解密后的返回数据。V1 实际请求需按《接入指南》用 VM 公钥加密后放入 `{"content":
        "密文"}`，返回的 `data` 需用商户私钥解密。


        - 获取交易流水
      tags:
        - VM卡操作 V1（仅限 2026-10-30 前已配置商户公钥的账户）
      parameters:
        - name: Authorization
          in: header
          description: ''
          example: '{{Authorization}}'
          schema:
            type: string
            default: '{{Authorization}}'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                page:
                  type: integer
                  description: '   默认1'
                  title: 页码
                page_size:
                  type: integer
                  description: 默认100 最大1000
                  title: 分页数量
                card_id:
                  type: string
                  title: 卡ID
                  description: 后续将废弃card_id，建议采用vm_card_id
                auth_id:
                  type: string
                  title: 交易ID
                transaction_type:
                  type: string
                  title: '交易类型 '
                  description: Authorization-消费授权，Settlement-清算，Refund-消费退款，Reversal-授权撤销
                status:
                  type: string
                  description: ' PENDING-清算中，DECLINED-交易失败，COMPLETE-清算完成'
                  title: 交易状态
                start_time:
                  type: string
                  title: 起始时间
                  description: 开始时间，按 auth_time 筛选，格式 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss，包含起止时间
                end_time:
                  type: string
                  title: 结束时间
                  description: 结束时间，按 auth_time 筛选，格式 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss，包含起止时间
                vm_card_id:
                  type: string
                  title: vm卡ID
              x-apifox-orders:
                - page
                - page_size
                - card_id
                - vm_card_id
                - auth_id
                - transaction_type
                - status
                - start_time
                - end_time
            example:
              vm_card_id: v4Qg*************HHSfg
              transaction_type: Settlement
              status: COMPLETE
              start_time: '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
              end_time: '2026-10-31 23:59:59'
              page: 1
              page_size: 100
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ''
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  code:
                    type: integer
                  msg:
                    type: string
                  data:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      total:
                        type: integer
                      list:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            auth_id:
                              type: string
                              description: 交易ID
                            card_id:
                              type: string
                              description: 卡 ID（后续将废弃，建议使用 vm_card_id）
                            auth_time:
                              type: string
                              description: 交易授权时间
                            auth_amount:
                              type: number
                              description: 授权金额
                            auth_currency:
                              type: string
                              description: 授权币种
                            settle_amount:
                              type: number
                              description: 结算金额
                            settle_currency:
                              type: string
                              description: 结算币种
                            status:
                              type: string
                              description: 交易状态
                            type:
                              type: string
                              description: 交易类型
                            merchant_name:
                              type: string
                              description: 交易商户
                            create_time:
                              type: string
                              description: 创建时间
                            description:
                              type: string
                              description: 交易详情（交易失败信息）
                            vm_card_id:
                              type: string
                              description: VM 卡 ID
                          x-apifox-orders:
                            - auth_id
                            - card_id
                            - auth_time
                            - auth_amount
                            - auth_currency
                            - settle_amount
                            - settle_currency
                            - status
                            - type
                            - merchant_name
                            - create_time
                            - description
                            - vm_card_id
                    required:
                      - total
                      - list
                    x-apifox-orders:
                      - total
                      - list
                required:
                  - code
                  - msg
                  - data
                x-apifox-orders:
                  - code
                  - msg
                  - data
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: 成功
      security: []
      x-apifox-folder: VM卡操作 V1（仅限 2026-10-30 前已配置商户公钥的账户）
      x-apifox-status: released
      x-run-in-apifox: https://app.apifox.com/web/project/6388598/apis/api-295812051-run
components:
  schemas: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
servers:
  - url: https://sandbox-api.vmcardio.com
    description: API开发者
security: []

```
